templates.title: Compress
templates.description: Reduce a captured file using Zstandard or one of its four compatibility codecs, preserving every original byte.

templates.title: Restore
templates.description: Recover original bytes from a captured compressed stream with a bounded fresh native decoder.

templates.title: Inspect
templates.description: Inspect complete Zstandard frame boundaries, sizes, windows, dictionary identities and checksums, backed by actual decoding.

templates.title: Encode delta
templates.description: Compress a changed snapshot relative to a captured earlier snapshot, retaining the reference needed for restoration.

templates.title: Concatenate
templates.description: Join complete Zstandard streams in a chosen order and prove that restoration yields the corresponding concatenated content.

templates.title: Compare profiles
templates.description: Compare compressed sizes for several format and level choices while proving exact restoration of every candidate.

templates.title: Train dictionary
templates.description: Learn a reusable, explicitly identified compression dictionary from a captured corpus of related small files.

templates.title: Benchmark
templates.description: Measure native in-memory compression and decompression throughput over captured representative content, with independently checked sizes and round trips.

templates.title: Benchmark decode
templates.description: Measure native in-memory decompression throughput of an existing captured Zstandard stream with its exact dictionary.

templates.title: Inspect dictionary
templates.description: Inspect a captured external trained or raw dictionary, including exact identity and fresh native loading in both compressor and decoder.

templates.title: Compress files
templates.description: Compress a reusable named or recursively selected file set, preserving relative names with bounded captured inputs and collision checks.

templates.title: Restore files
templates.description: Restore a captured compressed file set into collision-checked relative names under one aggregate decoded-output budget.
